summary: [Square] authorization: OAuth 2.0 with granular scopes: PAYMENTS_READ/WRITE, ORDERS_READ/WRITE, INVENTORY_READ/WRITE, CUSTOMERS_READ/WRITE, MERCHANT_PROFILE_READ. Scope gaps cause silent feature loss (webhooks need matching read scopes). Personal access tokens for single-seller dev. Request smallest scope; money-moving scopes are the most sensitive in this provider.
